metadata.title: Holder Sell Rule and the 1992 Switch-Sides Test

story.iWant: the holder to be able to lose its belief and sell
story.soThat: the note can test whether Black Wednesday needed the convergence traders to turn
story.tasks: - Exit rule (AC: 1, 2) - Sweep and scan (AC: 3, 4) - Chart (AC: 5) - Verdict, ADR, figures, close out (AC: 6–8)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–8. The exit rule in AC 1 (one-way, sell all, never re-enter) is normative.

docs.doc: Who the agent is now; why 25 C*; predictions.
Capped holder = redeemer in waiting; price paid decides.

existing.reason: Add hold_exit and the exited flag; snapshot it.
None on an axis, if not already possible.

story-context.constraints: - No kernel/ or protocol/ changes beyond config.py; PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1; every existing scenario hash unchanged. - Exit is one-way; the holder never re-enters; the sell is on the AMM, not a redemption. - Charts read parquet + manifest only. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: float | None = None; must exceed entry_discount_pct when set
--holder-capital, --exit, --range 4.0:7.0:0.1, --seed; prints the multiple table and the flip; --dry-run

tests.standards: pytest; holder tests with real AMM and manual phases per 1.7; hash test; sweep None-axis test; scan dry-run; synthetic parquet for the chart.
